goal: Prevent data races when concurrent IPC mining calls modify and read an active block template
Allow external mining clients to retrieve total template fees directly without summing individual fees
agreement: Strong support for fixing the IPC data race and adding the total fees getter (enirox001, ismaelsadeeq, w0xlt)
Verified using a new concurrent IPC functional test under TSAN (enirox001, ismaelsadeeq)
Alternative approach suggested to make templates non-mutating instead of adding a mutex (sedited)
Making templates non-mutating favored by reviewers while pending author response (ismaelsadeeq, w0xlt)

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because it fixes a data race between concurrent IPC worker threads handling block templates
Prevents corrupted reads or crashes when solutions are submitted while another thread reads the template
Improves the IPC mining interface efficiency by exposing total fees directly
